latestPosts.caption:
Can our TPUs survive and operate in space? There’s only one way to find out.

After years of research, Project Suncatcher is scheduled to embark on its first test in orbit.
Here's Jeffree wishing everyone a happy International Dog Day! 🐶
Sharing a few shots taken by #teampixel and Googlers on the new Pixel 11, in honor of World Photography Day!
Thanks to @lifeonfilm for giving me something to do at I/O.

That’s a wrap on Google I/O 2026! 

From the Shoreline stage to the Podcast Porch, we shared our latest advances and had a lot of fun with Gemini Omni (here it is reimagining my year 😅). Huge thanks to our incredible community, our partners, and the teams who made it all possible.
Got my hands on our new TPU 8s - beautiful!

Well done to everyone at @NASA on a successful launch today! Excited to commemorate this historic mission with today’s Doodle on our homepage. Incredible to think about all of the exciting things the Artemis II mission will unlock for future space travel. Godspeed to the crew!

A celebration of color, community, and new beginnings. Happy Holi to all!

Incredible shot by @prajai_k taken on Pixel 8 Pro.

My favorite part of traveling anywhere is spending time with Googlers around the world.

Even more true when @shubmangill is there too!

Google India thank you for having me!

Packed first day at the AI Impact Summit in India. Enjoyed meeting with the Honorable PM @narendramodi and spending time with so many partners, students, and Googlers. Plus we made some big announcements on new subsea cables, science and skilling.

Even managed to get a bit of cricket in too :)  🇺🇸 🇮🇳
